rationale: Resolves YES if the deposit rate is unchanged at the Oct 28-29 meeting. The ECB hiked 25bp to 2.50% on Sept 10. The October meeting has no new staff projections, and analysts (Goldman, UBS) see December as the next possible move while MUFG sees the cycle as done. Holding at a non-projection meeting right after a hike is the usual pattern. Search results showed market-derived odds; I ignored them.

Requires the Dome of the Rock to be physically destroyed before Netanyahu's term ends, and Israel votes on Oct 27, 2026. The base rate is essentially zero, and nothing in current news points that way.

The blockade has been in force since July. CENTCOM touts its effect, and Trump has said it stays in 'full force' and rejected Iran's offer to reopen Hormuz in exchange for lifting it. He has also pledged no strikes before the midterms and still mentions talks, so a deal that ends the blockade by Nov 30 is possible but unlikely given Hormuz attacks this week and a talk of MOAB strikes.

Needs both an announced US-Iran Hormuz agreement by Nov 2 and a Democratic Senate. A deal within about 2 weeks looks roughly 6-8% likely: the June MOU lapsed, the IRGC says Hormuz is 'closed', ships are being hit, and no talks are scheduled. Non-market forecasts give Democrats about 56-66% for the Senate. The product is about 4%. A search result showed a Kalshi figure; I ignored it.

Vucic's SNS-led list has won the most seats in every election since 2012 and has large incumbency and media advantages. The latest poll (Faktor Plus, Sept, government-leaning) has United Serbia at 48.6% vs 37.1% for the Student List, while the independent CRTA/DAL poll in June had the students ahead 44.9 to 35.7. That real uncertainty keeps me below the base rate. A search result showed a betting price; I ignored it.

Resolves YES if no US air or missile strike hits Iranian territory by Nov 15. Trackers report no US strike on Iran since Sept 8, and Trump has promised none before the Nov 3 midterms. Officials, however, say strike options (including MOAB on Pickaxe Mountain) are prepared and could come after the midterms, Hormuz clashes are escalating, and no ceasefire is formally in force. The Nov 4-15 window is the main risk.

Likud averages about 21-22 seats across trackers, and the latest mainstream polls show 18-20 (Maariv 18, Channel 13 20). Only the right-leaning Channel 14 and i24/Direct Polls show 25-26. Likud has historically matched or slightly beaten final polls, but not by 4 or more seats, so 25-29 is a tail outcome.

Rubio left the Senate, so the special election is on Nov 3. Appointed Sen. Ashley Moody (R) leads Democrat Angie Nixon by about 7 in polling averages (DDHQ 49.2 vs 42.3), and Florida has trended strongly Republican. A Democratic-leaning national environment and a few close polls (St. Pete 47-45) keep this from being higher.

A preliminary injunction bars USPS from enforcing the rule's mandatory parts for elections on or before Nov 3, 2026. The First Circuit denied a stay, and the Supreme Court refused to lift the injunction on Sept 14, with Kavanaugh noting there is too little time to implement it. Implementation for the midterms is very unlikely.

Resolves YES if no new Pro-labeled Gemini model is publicly released by Nov 1. Google's new flagship is 'Gemini 4 Argon' (GA Oct 13), which is not labeled Pro, and Gemini 3.5 Pro was reportedly dropped. A Gemini 4 Pro launch only two weeks after Argon's GA seems unlikely, though rumors of an October Pro release are the main risk.

Wilson leads the Republicans but trails Democrat Kreiss-Tomkins on first choices (44-24 Cygnal; 40-20 NYT/Siena). After ranked-choice tabulation she still loses 48-52 (Siena) and 46-54 (ASR), and Cook has shifted the race toward Democrats. Alaska's Republican lean and possible consolidation of Republican rankings give her a real but minority chance.

Requires a nationwide action that legalizes cannabis or removes criminal penalties for personal possession by Nov 3, 2026. Only medical and FDA-approved marijuana was moved to Schedule III in April 2026, and broader rescheduling is pending after a DEA hearing. Even full Schedule III status would keep criminal penalties, and no legalization bill is moving.
